scripts.dev: sh -c 'test -f .env.local || cp .env.local.example .env.local; bun run dev:api & api=$!; trap "kill $api" EXIT INT TERM; bunx vite'
scripts.dev:api: mkdir -p data/app && DATABASE_URL="file:$PWD/data/app/travel.db" bunx prisma migrate deploy && DATABASE_URL="file:$PWD/data/app/travel.db" NODE_ENV=development bun --env-file=.env.local --watch server/index.mjs
scripts.local:up: mkdir -p data/app data/tinyauth && touch data/tinyauth/users && docker compose --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml up --build
scripts.auth:user: mkdir -p data/tinyauth && touch data/tinyauth/users && docker compose --env-file .env.local -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml run --rm tinyauth user create --interactive
